Nothing is wired into gameplay, no shader or existing file was edited, and nothing was committed. The `--import` step was not needed or run. The env says this folder is not a git repository, so I did not run git status.

  - Root `FirePitFlames` is a Node3D with no script. It has two GPUParticles3D children, `Flames` (local y 0.2) and `Embers` (local y 0.35).

  - Both emitters use one shared radial `GradientTexture2D` written in the scene (32×32, white centre to transparent edge), built the way hit_spark.tscn did it.
  - The brief doesn't name `fixed_fps` or `interpolate` for B. I followed Effect A's precedent: `fixed_fps = 0` and `interpolate = true`, and the test checks both, labelled as precedent.
- D:\CSYE 7370\csye-7270-course\fall-2026\jingyao-y\assignment-6\walker-downfall\tests\test_fire_pit_flames_config.gd
  - Modelled on test_hit_spark_config.gd. It reads back from the loaded resources the root class and name, no script, and exactly two children.
  - Per emitter it checks every shared and per-emitter setting in the brief, including emission shape and radius, every turbulence value, scale curve points and samples, colour ramp stops, QuadMesh size, all material flags and the texture.
  - It also checks that the two emitters share one texture, and exits 1 on any failure.
- D:\CSYE 7370\csye-7270-course\fall-2026\jingyao-y\assignment-6\walker-downfall\previews\fire_pit_flames_preview.gd and fire_pit_flames_preview.tscn
